{"predictors": [
{"name": "Revenue Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) of a firm's revenue streams from different business segments over the past 3 years, using Compustat Segments data", "rationale": "Firms with more concentrated revenue streams may be more vulnerable to industry-specific shocks, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Volatility", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of year-over-year changes in total employees over the past 5 years, using Compustat employee data", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile employee growth may be more likely to experience future operating disruptions, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capex-to-Depreciation Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of capital expenditures to depreciation expense over the past year, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high capex-to-depreciation ratios may be investing aggressively in future growth opportunities, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "Count the number of unique suppliers and customers mentioned in a firm's 10-K filings over the past 3 years, using Thomson Financial text analysis", "rationale": "Firms with more complex supply chains may be more exposed to operational and logistical risks, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Busyness", "construction": "Calculate the average number of other public company board seats held by a firm's board members, using IRRC board data", "rationale": "Firms with busier board members may have less effective corporate governance, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Carbon Intensity", "construction": "Estimate a firm's carbon emissions per dollar of sales over the past year, using EPA data and Compustat sales data", "rationale": "Firms with high carbon intensity may face future regulatory and reputational risks, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Underfunding", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of a firm's pension plan liabilities to assets over the past year, using Compustat pension data", "rationale": "Firms with underfunded pension plans may face future cash outflows and reputational risks, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Lifecycle Stage", "construction": "Classify a firm's products into introductory, growth, maturity, or decline stages based on patent filings and citation patterns, using USPTO data", "rationale": "Firms with products in earlier lifecycle stages may have more uncertain future cash flows, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "earlier stages of the measure"},
{"name": "Institutional Investor Dispersion", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of institutional investor holdings across different funds and managers over the past quarter, using Thomson Financial 13F data", "rationale": "Firms with more dispersed institutional investor bases may have less informed and less effective corporate governance, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Textual Sentiment Volatility", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of sentiment scores extracted from a firm's 10-K and 10-Q filings over the past 3 years, using Thomson Financial text analysis", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile textual sentiment may be more likely to experience future earnings surprises and stock price volatility, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
